title: Wolfenstein 3 is officially in production 🔫
subject: wolfenstein
description:
Who else waited 9 years for this? 👇

Xbox confirmed on November 12, 2026 at its 25th anniversary FanFest that Wolfenstein 3 is in production at MachineGames, with Brian Bloom and Debra Wilson returning as B.J. Blazkowicz and Grace Walker. No platforms or release date yet.

Sources: Xbox Wire 25th anniversary recap (Nov 12, 2026), Inven Global, Beebom
Game footage © Bethesda Softworks / MachineGames.

scenes.text: On November 12, at its 25th anniversary FanFest, Xbox confirmed the game is in production at MachineGames in Sweden.

scenes.text: Brian Bloom returns as B.J. Blazkowicz, and Debra Wilson is back as Grace Walker.
The last chapter, The New Colossus, came out in October 2017. That's a 9-year wait.
Xbox CEO Asha Sharma said the series has an important place in gaming history.
No trailer, platforms or release date yet. Sharma also said id Software's next project is in development.
